correctness.rationale: For each k>0 and A>2k the proof solves all four constant-forcing harmonic arcs, explicitly matches points (0,-v),(-A,0),(0,+w),(A,0) and checks transversality. Lower-half-plane energy E_-=A(A-2k)/2 enforces sharp necessity; A=2k hits the origin at t=pi. Differentiating exact arccos times gives a strictly negative period derivative. The universal conclusions are established algebraically, not inferred from finite checker grids. Limits exclude axial sliding and any other nonsmooth trajectories.

value.rationale: The natural constant-switching m=4 limit is exactly the first-order-averaging-degenerate case of an active nonsmooth Liénard question. The theorem resolves the nontrivial difference between zero averaged drift and an actual full-amplitude neutral annulus, proves the sharp grazing onset A=2k where cross-sector averaging loses transversality, and obtains the strict non-isochronous period law with limiting values. It is a motivated structural phase portrait and not a renamed standard coefficient substitution.
